title: DocMap client (cliente dell'anagrafica)
description: A client of the register as written by DocMap v11.1 (normalizeClient in assets/js/02-core.js, mapClient in 06c-clients.js): S.clients, workspace JSON, sync packages, server records of type 'client'. All values are trimmed strings with single spaces. The link to binders is BY VALUE (binder.multi_code = client.multi_code, or the same name case-insensitive): there is no client_id on the binder. Contract: docs/MODELLO-DATI.md §3.

multi_code.description: Codice Multi ('Ditta' column of the studio list): de-duplication key when present (case-insensitive).

name.description: Ragione sociale (required by the import: rows without a name are skipped).

cap.description: Postal code, kept as text (leading zeros).

category.description: ETS_ENC column (or TIPO when empty), e.g. APS.

notes.description: Free notes; the 'Codice_com' column becomes 'Cod. comune E547'.

color_hex.description: v10, optional: spine colour for the binders created from this client (import column Colore).

tags.description: v10, optional: tags copied to the binders created from this client.

updated_at.description: v10, set by the sync change tracking (06f-sync.js); not stored in the .sqlite.
